mfaCode.title: MFA code (only when prompted)
mfaCode.description: Leave blank for normal runs. AppFolio remembers this device for ~30 days, so MFA is only requested about once a month. When the Actor reports it needs MFA, paste the fresh code here and re-run once to refresh the saved session.

reports.title: Reports to export
reports.description: Which reports to export and their parameters. Defaults cover the three CFO reports.

googleServiceAccountJson.title: Google service account JSON
googleServiceAccountJson.description: Full JSON key of a Google service account that has been added as a member (Content manager) of the LIGHTHOUSE shared drive. Used to upload the PDFs.

driveFolderId.title: Destination Drive folder ID
driveFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID for LIGHTHOUSE > CFO Report Inbox.

sharedDriveId.title: Shared Drive ID
sharedDriveId.description: ID of the LIGHTHOUSE shared drive.

debugMode.title: Debug mode
debugMode.description: When true, saves screenshots + page HTML to the key-value store at each step so the AppFolio selectors/URLs can be verified and tuned. Turn this on for the first run.
